# Build and test dependencies for GitHub Actions on Fedora.
#
# Toolchain and debug tools.
make
gcc
binutils
nasm
gdb
clang-tools-extra

# 32-bit compiler support for Mario's -m32 builds.
glibc-devel.i686
libgcc.i686

# QEMU and raw-disk image generation. util-linux provides sfdisk/losetup.
qemu-system-x86
util-linux
dosfstools
e2fsprogs
mtools

# Archive and configure tools used by app builds.
wget
patch
tar
gzip
unzip
bison
byacc
autoconf
automake
libtool
pkgconf-pkg-config

# Test harness.
tmux
socat

# Python environment used by the lit runners and pre-commit.
python3
python3-pip

# Host Python build dependencies.
zlib-devel
libffi-devel
openssl-devel
readline-devel
sqlite-devel
bzip2-devel
xz-devel
libuuid-devel
ncurses-devel

# Additional CP437/iconv charmaps used by the font tooling.
glibc-gconv-extra
